wifi.title: Computer and TV on the same network
wifi.lead: Claude talks to the TV over your home network, and AirPlay from an iPhone only works on the same network.
steps: This computer is on the same Wi-Fi as the TV (or the TV is wired to the same router).
If your home has two routers with two different networks (e.g. 192.168.1.x and 192.168.2.x), AirPlay will not work across them.
The TV / box is switched on.

adb.title: Turn on ADB on the TV (once, with the remote)
adb.lead: This is the only step you do by hand. Everything after it is automatic.
steps: On the remote: Settings ⚙️ → System (or "Device Preferences") → About.
Scroll to "Android TV OS build" (or "Build") and press OK 7 times, until it says you are a developer.
Turn on "USB debugging". If there is also "Network debugging", turn it on too.
Leave the TV on this screen.

allow.title: Allow it on the TV
allow.lead: The TV will now show "Allow USB debugging?".
steps: No prompt? Turn USB debugging off and on again.

tv.title: Which TV?
tv.lead: These are the devices I found on your network. Pick the one to set up now.

choices.title: How should this TV look?
choices.lead: You can keep the defaults and press Continue.

fields.label: Room name (what the iPhone shows under AirPlay)
Apps on the home screen, in order
Which app opens when the TV is switched on (and when the box wakes up)
Voice search (the mic button on the remote)

options.label: Not used, turn it off (saves memory)

uninstall.title: Which apps should go?
uninstall.lead: These apps were installed on the TV and are not on the home screen. Ticked ones are removed; they can be reinstalled from the Play Store.

cec.title: One remote for TV and box (optional)
cec.lead: So the TV remote controls the box, and the box turns the TV on straight to it:
steps: Samsung: Settings → General & Privacy → Start Screen Options → turn off "Start with Smart Hub Home".
Samsung: Settings → Connection → External Device Manager → turn on Anynet+ (HDMI-CEC).
LG: SimpLink. Sony: Bravia Sync. Philips: EasyLink. Turn it on.
On the box it is already on; nothing to do there.

finish.title: Is everything working?
finish.lead: Check the TV for a moment: the home screen, your apps and AirPlay from the iPhone. If all is good, everything is cleaned up: the backups and temporary files are deleted (on the TV and on this computer) and ADB is closed.

options.label: All good: clean up and close (no backup left, no way back)
Leave it open with the backup (to change more)
